package com.synexia.primitives;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Bounded, primitive-only top-K projection over an exact source sort-signal lane.
 *
 * <p>The caller's indexed rows and the underlying payload lanes are never permuted. Only
 * the selected row IDs and (when heap pressure permits) their first signals are retained.
 * There is no per-row Entry, Node or comparator cache object. This is an exact lane sort,
 * not permission to substitute an unverified @Sortable heuristic for a comparator.
 *
 * <p>Selection costs O(n log k) comparisons, uses O(k) primitive slots, and sorts the
 * selected IDs in O(k log k). An optional long[] of active heap signals is dropped under
 * high/warm Xmx pressure, trading CPU rereads for lower retained allocation. No heap
 * sampling happens per candidate. Java/JNI data ownership remains with the source.</p>
 */
public final class M3SortableTopK {
    private static final int ALWAYS_CACHE_LIMIT = 32;

    private M3SortableTopK() { }

    static int[] select(PrimitiveSoaStore store, int[] rows, long sourceVersion,
            int lane, int maximum, boolean ascending) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(store, "store");
        Objects.requireNonNull(rows, "rows");
        PrimitiveKind kind = store.laneKind(lane); // Validate the signal even for empty results.
        if (maximum < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative top-K maximum");
        if (store.version() != sourceVersion) throw new java.util.ConcurrentModificationException();
        int count = Math.min(maximum, rows.length);
        if (count == 0) return new int[0];
        boolean cache = count <= ALWAYS_CACHE_LIMIT || M3RuntimeHeap.current()
                .pressure((long) count * Long.BYTES) == M3RuntimeHeap.Pressure.NORMAL;
        return select(store, rows, sourceVersion, lane, kind, count, ascending, cache);
    }

    /** Package-private pressure seam: test both cache and no-cache paths deterministically. */
    static int[] select(PrimitiveSoaStore store, int[] rows, long sourceVersion, int lane,
            PrimitiveKind kind, int count, boolean ascending, boolean cacheSignals) {
        if (count < 0 || count > rows.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("top-K count");
        if (store.version() != sourceVersion) throw new java.util.ConcurrentModificationException();
        if (count == 0) return new int[0];
        int[] heap = new int[count];
        long[] cached = cacheSignals ? new long[count] : null;
        int admitted = 0;
        for (int row : rows) {
            long signal = store.getBits(lane, row);
            if (admitted < count) {
                heap[admitted] = row;
                if (cached != null) cached[admitted] = signal;
                rise(heap, cached, admitted++, store, lane, kind, ascending);
            } else if (compare(row, signal, heap[0],
                    signal(heap, cached, 0, store, lane), kind, ascending) < 0) {
                heap[0] = row;
                if (cached != null) cached[0] = signal;
                sink(heap, cached, 0, count, store, lane, kind, ascending);
            }
        }
        if (store.version() != sourceVersion) throw new java.util.ConcurrentModificationException();
        // A max-heap of the worst selected candidate sorts into exact best-first order.
        for (int end = count - 1; end > 0; end--) {
            swap(heap, cached, 0, end);
            sink(heap, cached, 0, end, store, lane, kind, ascending);
        }
        if (store.version() != sourceVersion) throw new java.util.ConcurrentModificationException();
        return heap;
    }

    private static long signal(int[] heap, long[] cache, int at,
            PrimitiveSoaStore store, int lane) {
        return cache != null ? cache[at] : store.getBits(lane, heap[at]);
    }

    private static int compare(int leftId, long leftSignal, int rightId, long rightSignal,
            PrimitiveKind kind, boolean ascending) {
        int order = kind.compareBits(leftSignal, rightSignal);
        if (order == 0) order = Integer.compare(leftId, rightId);
        return ascending ? order : -order;
    }

    private static int compareAt(int[] heap, long[] cached, int a, int b,
            PrimitiveSoaStore store, int lane, PrimitiveKind kind, boolean ascending) {
        return compare(heap[a], signal(heap, cached, a, store, lane),
                heap[b], signal(heap, cached, b, store, lane), kind, ascending);
    }

    private static void rise(int[] heap, long[] cache, int at,
            PrimitiveSoaStore store, int lane, PrimitiveKind kind, boolean ascending) {
        while (at > 0) {
            int parent = (at - 1) >>> 1;
            if (compareAt(heap, cache, at, parent, store, lane, kind, ascending) <= 0) break;
            swap(heap, cache, at, parent);
            at = parent;
        }
    }

    private static void sink(int[] heap, long[] cache, int at, int size,
            PrimitiveSoaStore store, int lane, PrimitiveKind kind, boolean ascending) {
        while (at < (size >>> 1)) {
            int child = (at << 1) + 1;
            if (child + 1 < size && compareAt(heap, cache, child + 1, child,
                    store, lane, kind, ascending) > 0) child++;
            if (compareAt(heap, cache, child, at, store, lane, kind, ascending) <= 0) break;
            swap(heap, cache, at, child);
            at = child;
        }
    }

    private static void swap(int[] heap, long[] cache, int a, int b) {
        int id = heap[a]; heap[a] = heap[b]; heap[b] = id;
        if (cache != null) {
            long value = cache[a]; cache[a] = cache[b]; cache[b] = value;
        }
    }
}
